evals.prompt: Audit this TypeScript monorepo for our documented engineering-principles violations. Produce independently actionable findings, but do not fix source code.
evals.expected_output: Runs discovery and planning against AGENTS.md, writes a dated findings seam and self-contained action items, and leaves application source untouched.

evals.prompt: Only check imports, package boundaries, and duplicated behavior this time. Pause after findings.md so I can remove false positives.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the selected category subset, scans only those categories, writes resumable findings, and pauses before action-item expansion.

evals.prompt: Run ep-audit in this new repository. AGENTS.md still has TODO placeholders and Fallow is not installed.
evals.expected_output: Stops without scanning, explains the missing prerequisites, and directs the user to ep-setup and Fallow installation.

evals.prompt: Audit this Python repository for DRY and boundary violations. Do not fix source.
evals.expected_output: Stops because Fallow is not installed, and writes neither findings nor source.
